name: Lively Photos Director
subtitle: Direct natural photos
description: Lively Photos Director turns real-person reference photos and casual scene ideas into directions for believable photography, new-image generation, precise edits, consistent photo series, and visual QA. It separates scene mode from capture character, maps multiple reference images by role, keeps engine request parameters separate from prompt prose, and includes first-class GPT Image 2.5 Flare and Sunburst generation/editing guidance with explicit change and preserve boundaries. Image approval is based on actual output evidence when the host can inspect it.
capabilities: Direct believable new photographs from real-person reference images and casual scene ideas
Map multiple reference images by identity, wardrobe, environment, composition, lighting, style, background, or prop role
Separate scene mode, capture profile, subject scale, camera cues, and lighting into an engine-neutral direction packet
Compile GPT Image 2.5 Flare or Sunburst generation and editing packets with model and output controls separate from prompt prose
Define bounded edits with explicit CHANGE and PRESERVE sets, including multi-turn continuity requirements
Review actual generated images against likeness, anatomy, perspective, lighting, context, synthetic-residue, and edit-drift gates
Direct consistent photo series while varying shot size, camera relationship, and moment deliberately
Use host-native workspace capabilities for reference and output asset operations when the host provides them
starterPrompts: Use this reference photo to direct a believable partnership-signing image that feels naturally photographed, not staged
Make this look like a friend photographed me from far away on an ordinary beach with a normal phone camera feel
Change only the shirt in this generated photo and preserve my visible appearance, expression, pose, crop, lighting, and background
